text_blocks.snippet: Pikachu ex is a popular Lightning-type Pokémon card available across multiple sets in the Pokémon Trading Card Game Cards.

list.snippet: Surging Sparks (#57 / Special Illustration Rare #238 / #276): Features the Tera Pikachu ex with 200 HP, the Resolute Heart ability (survives a KO with 10 HP remaining if it has full HP), and the Topaz Bolt attack (300 damage for 3 Energy). High-rarity versions like the Pikachu ex #276 Pokemon Ascended Heroes often command market prices upwards of $750 to $875 USD.

Paldea Evolved (#063/193): A standard Double Rare card with 190 HP, featuring Pika Punch (30 damage) and Dynamic Bolt (220 damage, flip a coin to discard energy). It typically trades around $4.25 to $7.01 USD.
Prismatic Evolutions (#028/131): A Double Rare card with 190 HP that gives up 2 Prize cards when Knocked Out, generally valued between $2.59 and $7.99 USD.

30th Celebration / Special Illustration Rares (#149/128, #150/128): Features attacks like Pika-Pika Parade and Zip-Zap Frenzy, with collector market prices ranging past $65+ USD depending on condition.
